seed: The user, 2026-10-04: one drag of a Card put TWO Cards on the canvas, the copy and the original beside it. A drag now puts down one instance and nothing else; the original lives in the document's component library and Edit Original opens it in a space of its own, with Done in the title bar. This walk drops a Card twice at Next defaults, opens the original from a copy's right-click menu, fades it, comes back with Escape, and photographs both copies faded.

steps.note: ONE Card on the canvas, picked, and no notice about an original arriving
